Answers your home network only; uninstal: Inajibu mtandao wako wa nyumbani pekee; kuondoa programu, Wi-Fi na manenosiri vinabaki kwenye terminal
{n} short steps, then a review: nothing: Hatua fupi {n}, kisha mapitio: hakuna kinachobadilika kabla hujatekeleza. Zifungue tena wakati wowote: Mfumo → Hatua za kwanza tena.
Moving from an old card? Restore its bac: Unahamia kutoka kadi ya zamani? Rejesha nakala rudufu yake kwanza, kwenye terminal (sudo zenithboard backup restore FAILI): mipangilio, vilivyokuwa vimewashwa, takwimu na utambulisho wa mitandao vinarudi, na hatua hizi zinakuwa ukaguzi tu.
The decoder, MLAT and the wall's distanc: Kisimbuzi, MLAT na umbali unaoonyeshwa ukutani vinahitaji mahali hapa; hapaonyeshwi kamwe ukutani wala kwenye chapisho. Ukibofya kulia juu ya paa lako kwenye ramani, unapata namba hizo mbili.
The default of every screen; a tablet ca: Chaguomsingi la kila skrini; kompyuta kibao bado inaweza kujichagulia mwonekano wake kupitia aikoni ya gia.
Each network is added in the terminal: s: Kila mtandao huongezwa kwenye terminal: sudo zenithboard menu → 1 ADS-B → 1 Decoder and networks. Visakinishi vyao vyenyewe huuliza maswali njiani (jina la kituo, barua pepe, ufunguo wa kushiriki) na kutoa kiungo au msimbo wa kudai umiliki unaopaswa kuhifadhiwa: konsoli inaendesha amri zisizouliza chochote pekee, na haihifadhi ufunguo wowote.
ADSB Exchange comes first and is always: ADSB Exchange huja kwanza na huwa imewashwa kila wakati; FlightAware, Flightradar24 na Plane Finder ukizitaka tu. Hali yao inaonekana pia kwenye Muhtasari.
All of it stays on the card; nothing is: Vyote vinabaki kwenye kadi; hakuna kinachotumwa popote.
A sample every 15 minutes, 30 days kept:: Sampuli moja kila dakika 15, siku 30 zinahifadhiwa: ukurasa wa /stats na namba za mihtasari.
Years of the decoder's graphs on port 85: Miaka ya grafu za kisimbuzi kwenye lango 8542; kisakinishi cha mwandishi wake, dakika chache.
Registrations and models read on the car: Usajili na modeli husomwa kwenye kadi (tar1090).
Needs the receiver map (tar1090), not se: Inahitaji ramani ya kipokezi (tar1090), ambayo haikuonekana kwenye Pi hii.
Recommended for a Pi left alone. Each on: Inapendekezwa kwa Pi inayoachwa peke yake. Kila kimoja kikizimwa tena kinarudisha hali ilivyokuwa awali.
The chip restarts a frozen Pi after abou: Chipu huiwasha upya Pi iliyokwama baada ya takriban sekunde 10.
No router for 6 minutes: the network res: Ruta ikikosekana kwa dakika 6: mtandao unawashwa upya; 12: Pi.
Up to 50 MB, to read what happened befor: Hadi 50 MB, ili kusoma kilichotokea kabla ya kukwama.
Debian's security channel only; feeders: Chaneli ya usalama ya Debian pekee; feeder hazibadilishwi, hakuna kuwasha upya.
Retry without end after a loss; no radio: Kujaribu tena bila kikomo baada ya muunganisho kupotea; hakuna kuokoa nishati ya redio.
Account @{account}. Posting each crossin: Akaunti @{account}. Kuchapisha kila ndege inayopita kunawashwa kwenye Kushiriki; mihtasari, hapa.
No Bluesky account on this Pi: it is set: Hakuna akaunti ya Bluesky kwenye Pi hii: inawekwa kwenye terminal (inaomba nenosiri la programu): sudo zenithboard social setup. Ruka hatua hii hadi wakati huo.
The summaries come with the account: the: Muhtasari huja pamoja na akaunti: utaonyeshwa hapa baada ya akaunti kuwekwa.
Every day at its time (21:00 unless chan: Kila siku kwa wakati wake (21:00 isipobadilishwa kwenye Kushiriki), kutoka kwenye takwimu.
Sunday 19:00 unless changed; four posts,: Jumapili 19:00 isipobadilishwa; machapisho manne, kwa tofauti ya dakika mbili.
They need the statistics: switch them on: Inahitaji takwimu: ziwashe katika hatua ya 5.
Scan a QR code once and the phone stays: Changanua msimbo wa QR mara moja na simu itabaki imeingia, bila kuandika nenosiri, mradi tu inafungua konsoli mara moja kwa mwezi. Face ID na funguo za siri zinahitaji HTTPS chini ya jina la kikoa, kitu ambacho Pi iliyo kwenye anwani ya nyumbani haina.
A computer's sign-in page then shows a Q: Kisha ukurasa wa kuingia wa kompyuta unaonyesha msimbo wa QR; simu inakubali, bila nenosiri.
Applied one after the other; each is the: Yanatekelezwa moja baada ya jingine; kila moja ni amri ya zenithboard unayoweza kuisoma kwenye Shughuli.
Kila kitu tayari kiko kama ulivyochagua.
Latitude: a number between -90 and 90, e: Latitudo: namba kati ya -90 na 90, k.m. 49.1193
Longitude: a number between -180 and 180: Longitudo: namba kati ya -180 na 180, k.m. 6.1757
Altitude: metres above the sea, e.g. 180: Mwinuko: mita juu ya usawa wa bahari, k.m. 180
Receiver map's aircraft database: Hifadhidata ya ndege ya ramani ya kipokezi
Monthly aircraft-data refresh: Usasishaji wa kila mwezi wa data ya ndege
This change did not come from the consol: Badiliko hili halikutoka kwenye ukurasa wa konsoli yenyewe.
Signing in with a phone is off: sudo zen: Kuingia kwa simu kumezimwa: sudo zenithboard console phone-signin on
Too many sign-in codes from this address: Misimbo mingi mno ya kuingia kutoka kwenye anwani hii. Subiri dakika chache.
No console password yet: sudo zenithboar: Bado hakuna nenosiri la konsoli: sudo zenithboard console password (au oanisha simu: sudo zenithboard console pair)
